consumer: A frontend/engine caller asking 'does the avatar currently have line of sight to this nearby tile?' — a computed visibility/LOS predicate, not raw state or a display proxy.
scope: Pure geometric line-of-sight from the avatar to the tile (unobstructed sightline within sight range), NOT light/illumination-gated 'can actually see it' visibility.
decisive_source: map::pl_sees (the source of the 'seen' value): returns whether the PLAYER actually SEES the tile, factoring light level and apparent range, not merely whether an unobstructed line of sight exists.
divergence: A tile in total darkness with a clear unobstructed sightline at close range: there IS line of sight, but pl_sees returns false (no light), so the surface reports 'no LOS' for a tile the avatar geometrically can see — wrong scope (visibility conflated with line of sight).
